items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: I used to laugh, it would be so interesting to watch them work, you know. They were really nice.

ctx.x: What kind of act were they?

Jig-Saw Jackson. They were a dancing team, a trio, a dancing trio, three brothers, called The Berry Brothers. They were some dancers, too. Did a number called 'Papa Dee-Da-Da' used to strut to it, you know. It was terrific, yeah. And I used to laugh, it would be so interesting to watch them work, you know. They were really nice. 'Course all of them are dead now, except one, the youngest one, he's still alive, he's living in California.
Did they do a lot of acrobatics?
